command:
set -euo pipefail
R=rig_v2_incoming/FRANK_AVATAR_RIG_V2
test -f "$R/manifest.json"
echo '=== ROOT ==='; stat -c '%n size=%s mtime=%y' "$R/manifest.json"; sha256sum "$R/manifest.json" rig2/manifest.json; cmp -s "$R/manifest.json" rig2/manifest.json && echo MANIFEST_IDENTICAL=YES || echo MANIFEST_IDENTICAL=NO
echo '=== COUNTS ==='; find "$R" -type f -printf '%P\n' | awk -F/ '{c[$1]++} END{for(k in c) print k,c[k]}' | sort; echo TOTAL_FILES=$(find "$R" -type f | wc -l); du -sh "$R"
echo '=== TOP FILES ==='; find "$R" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' | sort | head -100
echo '=== IMAGE QA ==='; python3 - "$R" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import json,sys,hashlib,collections
r=Path(sys.argv[1]); m=json.loads((r/'manifest.json').read_text()); assets=m.get('assets',[]); miss=[]; broken=[]; quality=collections.Counter(); layers=collections.Counter(); rgba=[]; dims=collections.Counter(); bytes_total=0
for a in assets:
 quality[a.get('quality','UNSET')]+=1; layers[a.get('layer','UNSET')]+=1; p=r/a['path']
 if not p.is_file(): miss.append(a['path']); continue
 bytes_total+=p.stat().st_size
 try:
  im=Image.open(p); im.load(); dims[str(im.size)]+=1
  if a.get('rgba'):
   al=im.convert('RGBA').getchannel('A'); lo,hi=al.getextrema(); rgba.append((a['path'],lo,hi))
 except Exception as e: broken.append(a['path']+':'+repr(e))
print('MANIFEST_ASSETS',len(assets)); print('MISSING',len(miss),miss[:10]); print('BROKEN',len(broken),broken[:10]); print('ASSET_BYTES',bytes_total); print('LAYERS',dict(layers)); print('QUALITY',dict(quality)); print('DIMS',dict(dims)); print('RGBA_DECLARED_PRESENT',len(rgba)); print('RGBA_WITH_TRANSPARENCY',sum(lo<255 for _,lo,hi in rgba)); print('RGBA_ALL_OPAQUE',sum(lo==255 for _,lo,hi in rgba)); print('INCOMING_QA=PASS' if not miss and not broken else 'INCOMING_QA=FAIL')
PY
echo '=== LIVE HASH ==='; sha256sum buehne.html
